name: hearmeout
description: HearMeOut: turn any document into audio you can learn from. Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js) and apps/api (FastAPI).

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api --no-sync python -m uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api --no-sync python -m ruff check app tests
